is...

"Thank goodness... Actually, I made some 
potpourri out of lavender—"

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
"The scent of lavender has properties that 
alleviate headaches, so—"
choice_data_list: Huh, you have a headache!? Are you okay?
Huh, you have a headache!? Are you okay?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I'm fine— I took my medicine, and 
thanks to the aroma, it's gotten much—

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm sorry, it seems... I'm not quite 
at my best—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Seeing Curren Bouquetd'or suffer from a 
headache filled me with pure worry.
